summary: Frontend-only verification of new /ai-solutions route plus shared header/footer link updates. Ran 62 Playwright assertions covering: direct load + hard refresh of /ai-solutions with correct document title 'AI Solutions — Raystrat Systems' and meta description; all 8 sections (hero, delivery, applications, context, deliverables, engagement, questions, final) rendered via data-testids; 3 application blocks each with flow list + 'Define before building:' line; 4 deliverables; 4 engagement steps; 5 FAQ questions with answers present in markup (verified via text length) and native <details> toggling via both click and keyboard Enter; hero secondary CTA scroll to #applications with eyebrow below sticky header (offset ~193px below header); hero-primary and final CTAs both href='/#contact'; header nav hrefs (/ai-solutions, /#forward-deployed, /#how-we-work) and wordmark '/'; wordmark navigates to homepage; homepage hero-secondary-cta and footer-link-ai-solutions both link to /ai-solutions and successful navigation; mobile menu open/close with aria-expanded flip and 'open' class on mobile-nav at 390px; no horizontal overflow at 1920, 390 and 320 widths; homepage regression: all 8 homepage sections still render and form-preview-note still visible. All 62/62 checks passed with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AiSolutions page is static server component using Next.js metadata API correctly — title and description resolve at HTML level (verified via hard refresh).
Buyer questions use native <details>/<summary>, so answers remain in DOM when collapsed — good for SEO and matches spec.
SiteFooter is a server component (no 'use client') and correctly reused between pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 passed 62/62 checks on the new /ai-solutions route and shared nav/footer updates. Testids wired: ais-hero-section/eyebrow/heading, ais-hero-primary-cta (->/#contact), ais-hero-secondary-cta (->#applications), ais-delivery-section, ais-applications-section, ais-application-01/02/03, ais-flow-01/02/03, ais-applications-note, ais-context-section, ais-deliverables-section, ais-deliverable-<id> (4), ais-engagement-section, ais-engagement-01..04, ais-questions-section, ais-question-<id>/ais-question-toggle-<id>/ais-answer-<id> (5 each), ais-final-section, ais-final-cta. Header nav: nav-link-ai-solutions/forward-deployed/how-we-work, wordmark-home-link, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-nav. Footer: footer-link-ai-solutions/forward-deployed/how-we-work/contact. Homepage regression clean.
